extDescription.message: Delete history, cookies and cache of the sites you choose: on visit, on tab close or on a schedule. Other sites stay.

notWebHint.message: Open the site you want, then click the icon again

domainTooBroad.message: $1 is a shared zone that many sites use. Add a specific site, e.g. example.$1

noSites.message: No sites in the list yet

sweepTargetsLabel.message: Delete now clears the history of

sweepAllShort.message: Delete history of all listed sites

dataTitle.message: Delete cookies and cache when the last tab closes. Signs you out of the whole main domain.

dataAria.message: Also delete cookies and site data of $1

sweepDataNote.message: Also cleared cookies and site data of $1 sites.

scheduleDesc.message: Deletes all history of every listed site on a schedule, even with the tab open.

welcomeDesc.message: Pick the sites you don't want in your history. The rest stays.

welcomeStep2.message: Pick Delete on visit or Delete on tab close

welcomeStep3.message: Pin the icon from the puzzle-piece menu

popupUnsupported.message: This browser version can't open the popup by itself

headline.message: Sites to keep out of history

domainPlaceholder.message: Type a domain or paste a URL, e.g. youtube.com

hintWillDelete.message: Will delete the history of $1 and $2

emptyList.message: No sites yet. Add your first one above.

hideNamesDesc.message: Show as •••••• and leave out of the popup

hideTitle.message: Show as •••••• and leave out of the popup

pwTitleUnlock.message: Enter your password to see hidden sites

pwNote.message: You can't recover it. It locks the screen only.

forgotDesc.message: You can't recover the password. Delete the $1 hidden sites and add them again. You can't undo this.

forgotDone.message: Deleted $1 hidden sites and the password

autoSweepDesc.message: Catches leftovers for Delete on visit sites. Scans recent history only.

badgeDesc.message: Items deleted since the browser started

popupDesc.message: Drops down from the icon and closes after 4 seconds.

sweepNowDesc.message: Deletes all past history of these sites. Other sites stay.

backupDesc.message: Move your list to another computer or keep a copy. Anyone can read the site names in the file, so keep it safe.

importTooLarge.message: This file is too large to be an AutoClean History backup (max $1 KB)

importWrongFormat.message: This isn't an AutoClean History backup file

importNewer.message: A newer version of AutoClean History made this backup. Update the extension first.

importTooMany.message: That's more than $1 sites, over the limit

importEmpty.message: There are no usable sites or settings in this file

importSummaryMerge.message: AutoClean will add $1 new sites. $2 sites already in your list keep their mode.

importSummaryReplace.message: Your list will match the $1 sites in this file: $2 removed, $3 with a new mode.

importVisitWarn.message: Importing deletes all past history of these $1 sites right away (Delete on visit). You can't undo this.

importLangNote.message: Reopen this page to see the new language.

visitLi1.message: Deletes each page as you visit it, so nothing stays in history

visitLi2.message: Re-sweeps when the tab closes too

visitLi3.message: Re-sweeps on the interval above and when the browser starts

closeLi1.message: History stays while you use the site. AutoClean deletes it when the last tab closes

closeLi2.message: Several tabs open → AutoClean waits for the last one

closeLi3.message: Closed the whole browser at once → AutoClean cleans up at next start

footnote.message: Everything stays on this device. AutoClean History sends nothing anywhere.
